name: hardening_tangent_cc_coincident
_note: BUG-1 regression guard. Two circles drawn with EXACTLY coincident centers, then an internal circle-circle tangent is applied. At d=0 the distance direction (C1-C0)/|C1-C0| is 0/0; without a deterministic fallback the position Jacobian is null and Newton cannot separate the centers (it corrupts the radii instead). With the (1,0) fallback the inner circle's center is pushed along +x to the |r0-r1| internal-tangency distance. e1 fully fixed (center+radius), e2 radius pinned at 5, centers kept horizontal -> dof=0. Expected: e2.center=(5,0), internal tangency |r0-r1|=5.
